notes: HONEST: the SMS pipeline did NOT auto-fire. I grounded in Evergreen (that part is natural/instinctive once 'use evergreen' is said), but I then wrote copy directly as free text. The sms-draft skill, the qa-gate/benchmark-copy QA step, and the voice-profile skill never activated. Root cause: none of those skills are registered in this session's available-skills list (only superpowers/anthropic-skills/frontend-design/dataviz are) - so there is nothing for the model to auto-select, and the prompt did not name them. This is the YS Digital gap: skill discovery/routing is not wired, so a bare prompt defaults to plain copywriting. What would have made them fire: (a) the skills being present in the available-skills registry with trigger-rich descriptions ('cold SMS', 'write copy', 'campaign copy'), and/or (b) a CLAUDE.md / router rule in this repo that says copy requests must go through sms-draft -> benchmark-copy -> qa-gate, and/or (c) the strategist naming the pipeline.
